MIT source terms and SkillOpt attribution were inspected; they do not grant blanket rights to external datasets. No source code or dataset is redistributed here.

sources.locator: Sections 3.1–3.4 (construction and protocol); Section 4 and Table 1 (comparisons)

review.artifact: Evaluation resource, not an evolving method: the benchmark supplies cumulative capabilities; evaluated systems may retain their own adaptive state.
review.feedback: Verifier-scored tasks; cumulative adaptation examples are available before separate held-out measurement.
review.retention: Deployment resets internal state; adaptation carries memory, prompts, or code between harness stages.
review.evaluation: EnterpriseOps-Gym and Agentic Last Exam comparisons include task-specific capability references, memory/prompt/code adaptation, performance, cost, and forward/backward transfer.
review.safety: Benchmark execution and isolation not assessed; no code was run
review.conflictOfInterest: No connection identified in this screening; no external COI declaration obtained
limitations: Selected sections only; no complete statistical or artifact audit. Retention and adaptation gains are setting-dependent.
The construction adds capabilities without removal or modification. Keyword-derived skill annotations are heuristic, not guaranteed necessary or sufficient.
A paper and project page do not establish a complete executable release; artifact availability remains to be audited.
